title: Hardcoded Third-Party API Secret Key in Dart Service
description: A Dart service embeds a live third-party secret key (`sk_live_...`) directly in client source code to authenticate billing and AI moderation calls directly from the handset.
attack_vector: Extracting strings from the compiled Flutter binary reveals the `sk_live_` master secret key, allowing adversaries to issue unauthorized refunds, read customer billing records, or exhaust API quotas.
fix_rationale: Route third-party API operations requiring secret keys through a trusted backend proxy that issues scoped, ephemeral client tokens.
